user.title: New ventilation zone
user.description: Group all rooms that share one air volume into one zone.

data_description.name: A zone is one connected air volume, e.g. living room with open kitchen.
data_description.windows: All windows of the zone. Leave out inner doors.
data_description.humidity_sensors: All humidity sensors of the zone; they are averaged.
data_description.temperature_sensors: All temperature sensors of the zone; they are averaged.
data_description.weather: Provides outdoor dew point and temperature.
data_description.outdoor_dew_point_sensor: Overrides the weather entity's dew point.
data_description.initial_time_constant: How fast the air is exchanged (minutes). Take it over from an existing setup or keep 60.
data_description.initial_runs: How many airings the initial time constant is based on (affects learning weight).

error.no_windows: Select at least one window contact.
error.no_humidity: Select at least one humidity sensor.
error.no_temperature: Select at least one temperature sensor.
error.no_outdoor: Select a weather entity or an outdoor dew point sensor.

data_description.windows: All windows of the zone. Leave out inner doors.
data_description.humidity_sensors: All humidity sensors of the zone; they are averaged.
data_description.temperature_sensors: All temperature sensors of the zone; they are averaged.
data_description.weather: Provides outdoor dew point and temperature.
data_description.outdoor_dew_point_sensor: Overrides the weather entity's dew point.
data_description.open_delay: A window must be open this long before airing starts.
data_description.min_gap: Below this gap to the equilibrium humidity, airing only means fresh air (5 min).
data_description.marginal_rate: Airing ends when the expected drop falls below this many points per minute.
data_description.min_gap_fraction: Air at least until this share of the gap is closed (0.2 = 20 %).
data_description.spike_delta: Ignore a humidity sensor that is this far above the driest one (e.g. cooking). 0 = off.
data_description.reminder_after: Fire a reminder event if windows are still open this long after 'close now'.
data_description.settle_max: After closing, wait for the first humidity report, at most this long, then learn.
data_description.cooldown: 'Airing worthwhile' stays off this long after airing.
